title: ARS QC Pre-flight Agent — Output (successPreflightReport | errorEnvelope)
description: Validates the polymorphic v1.0 output of the QC Pre-flight Agent (Agent #7 of 17). Authored Day 45 (Wed Jun 3 2026) from SPEC §3 Outputs (Day 40 outline) + §6 9-code/slot-11 errorEnvelope (Day 41 §6.3 LOCKED) + §10 Field Map 26 rows (Day 41) + §12 deterministic verdict math (Day 43) + §16 metadata block + §16.5 schema authoring decisions (Day 43). Polymorphism via top-level oneOf — mirrors AI Video Gen Day 14 + Style Replication Day 33 pattern. successPreflightReport <=> verdict 'pass'; errorEnvelope <=> verdict in {fail, reshoot, hold}. 9 LOCKED failure codes + slot-11 catch-all enumerated via enum (§16.5 #4 — folded codes qc_pre_flags_format_violation / negative_prompt_chain_break NOT enumerated). brand_voice_qc.per_point minItems/maxItems 11, name constrained to the 11 snake_case point names from §7 (§16.5 #5). verdict_evidence_hash pattern ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ (§16.5 #6). human_review_required const true (§16.5 #7 — recommend-don't-approve, schema-enforced). mode_b_chain_check type [object, null] (§16.5 #8). DEFERRED (Decision #5 / §16.5 #1): parent_chain held at minItems 5 + optional 6th preflight_report_id position (maxItems 6, items false) — backward-compatible, accepts both the 5-tuple inbound canon AND the 6-tuple QC extension preview. TODO@schemas-day-followup: when Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment ratifies, flip to minItems 6 (exact-6) per §16.5 #1. The 6-tuple is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run.

successPreflightReport.description: verdict='pass' branch (§3.1). Emitted only when all 13 PASS-conjunction terms are true (§12 deterministic AND-of-gates, zero tunable thresholds): firewall clean (hits==0) AND 11/11 brand-voice AND 0 format violations AND caption sub-statuses pass AND cost within_ceiling AND floor met (agents_reporting==6, floor_met_all, 0 negative_predicates) AND unresolved_drift_count==0. human_review_required is const true even on pass (a pass = cleared to advance to the human's publish decision, NOT published — Rule #12).

brand_voice_qc.description: 11-point Brand Voice QC gate result (§3.1 / §10 rows 10-12). points_passed==11 is the gate-pass invariant on this branch.

entity_firewall_pass_7.description: The 7th-pass firewall result (§10 row 9). hits MUST be 0 on a pass verdict; any hit => entity_firewall_breach (errorEnvelope branch).

format_spec_check.description: §10 row — platform_variants_checked == len(production_plan.platform_variants); all violation counts 0 on pass.

caption_spec_check.description: §10 row — both sub-statuses pass on a pass verdict (burn-in firewall + caption-burn parity).

cost_ledger_check.description: §10 row — cumulative_reel_usd = sum(production agents) + self-cost; within_ceiling on pass. First agent with total-spend visibility.

qc_pre_flags_adjudication.description: §10 row — the §3.4 floor adjudication. On pass: agents_reporting==6, floor_met_all true, negative_predicates==0.

drift_reconciliation.description: §10 row — a pass verdict REQUIRES unresolved_drift_count==0 (the forbidden auto-pass-over-drift defect is schema-blocked here).

handoff_targets.description: §10 row — non-empty only on pass. v1.0 = the two terminal downstream stages.

cost_incurred_usd.description: This agent's own self-cost ($0.00-$0.02; reasoning-only + optional native pHash/CLIP re-verify). Generative engine spend FORBIDDEN ($0 ceiling, not bounded).

errorEnvelope.description: verdict in {fail, reshoot, hold} branch (§3.2). fail = fixable without re-shooting (route to responsible upstream agent). reshoot = Mode A source footage unusable (route to production-coord-agent; Mode A-exclusive per Decision #14). hold = drift_unresolved soft-hold (the one human-deferred outcome — NOT auto-failed, NOT auto-passed). human_review_required const true on every branch.

failure_code.description: 9 LOCKED codes (Day 41 §6.3) + slot-11 catch-all preflight_qc_agent_failed (Cross-SPEC §3.6). Folded codes (qc_pre_flags_format_violation -> qc_pre_flags_floor_breach; negative_prompt_chain_break -> lineage_integrity_failure) are NOT enumerated per §16.5 #4.

failed_check_id.description: Which §6 self-QC check produced the verdict (1..12).

attempts.description: Self-QC 2-strike ceiling (§6 retry policy). attempts==2 accompanies preflight_qc_agent_failed.

route_back_to.description: §3.2 verdict<->route map. null on hold (human review); responsible upstream agent on fail; production-coord-agent on reshoot (Mode A only).

detail.description: Free-form failure context (violation, affected_platform, recovery_path, upstream_failure, per-agent cost attribution, failing brand-voice point ids, etc.). Advisory recovery_path is surfaced, NOT auto-executed (Decision #13 ADVISORY in v1.0).

allOf.description: Decision #14 — reshoot is Mode A-exclusive and routes to production-coord-agent. A reshoot verdict MUST carry route_back_to: production-coord-agent.
§3.2 / Step 8 — hold is the drift_unresolved soft-hold; verdict held, routed to human (route_back_to null), failure_code drift_unresolved.

reelRefFull.description: Full reel reference triple (§3.1) — the cross-record audit join keys.

reelRefMinimal.description: Minimal reel reference on the errorEnvelope branch (§3.2) — at minimum the emitting agent's own identity.

preflightReportId.description: v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens prefix). This agent's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element.

brandVoicePerPoint.description: Exactly 11 entries (§16.5 #5). Each name constrained to the 11 canonical snake_case point names from §7. Each evidence non-empty.

brandVoicePerPointAllPass.description: Success-branch-strict variant: every one of the 11 points MUST carry status 'pass' (§12 PASS conjunction — 11/11 brand-voice). This makes a false-pass (points_passed=11 alongside a failing point) STRUCTURALLY impossible, not merely emitter-discipline. A reel with >=1 failing point routes to the errorEnvelope branch (brand_voice_qc_failed), not here.

modeBChainCheck.description: §16.5 #8 — populated Mode B (forensic SHA-256 passthrough cross-check); null Mode A / Mode C (§10.5 matrix). passthrough_intact_bool==false => lineage_integrity_failure.

qcPreFlagsEmitted.description: QC Pre-flight's own emitted predicates (§3.7 snake_case, >=4 — Check #12). e.g. entity_firewall_clean_pass_7, eleven_point_gate_all_green, cost_within_combined_ceiling, no_unresolved_drift_auto_passed.

sessionId.description: Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

parentChainHeld.description: DEFERRED (Decision #5 / §16.5 #1). Held at minItems 5 with an OPTIONAL 6th preflight_report_id position (maxItems 6, items false). This is the additive, backward-compatible encoding: it ACCEPTS the 5-tuple inbound canon AND the 6-tuple QC extension preview, and REJECTS a 4-tuple. TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: when the n-tuple amendment ratifies, flip to minItems 6 (exact-6) per §16.5 #1 — the 6-tuple is then mandatory, not optional. NOT auto-advanced this run.

metadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block (§16.1) + 4 QC Pre-flight additions (§16.2): qc_gate_class, verdict_evidence_hash, runtime_environment_class, + the parent_chain 6th position. human_review_required const true (§16.5 #7).

qc_gate_class.description: v1.0 = pre_flight (production->post boundary). pre_publish reserved for v1.1+ post-Motion gate.

verdict_evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex, 64) over the canonicalized per-check evidence block (§12.5). Tamper-evident verdict; the false-pass review audit anchor.

runtime_environment_class.description: Inherited from AI Video Gen §16. Gates production-only behaviors (contested-drift fingerprint re-verify is staging/production only).
